notes: Adds the SAMP and TAREV commands: on request the scale sends fresh numbered load-cell measurements (no tare), and performs a verified tare that zeroes only if the load still matches the cup the screen verified. Both are used only by screen 2.10.0 for the grinder-start recovery when the scale was off; older screens are unaffected. Advertising, power saving, deep sleep, TARE, calibration, BLE and updates are unchanged. Install this scale update first.
